violations.text: The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (chlorine ) sanitizing solution for the ( 3 bay sink). Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026
Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026
All handwashing sinks is lacking handwashing signage. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine ) were observed with an accumulation of black residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Unit was taken out of service to be washed and sanitized. Ice disposed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the (2 dr reach in ) refrigeration unit(s). Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (chlorine ) sanitizing solution for the (3 bay sink). New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026

The ice machine is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026
The receptacle in the women's toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (back storage) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026
The (wall ) in the (kitchen ) area is in poor repair. Observed a hole The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026
